ordering: Root arm order alternates; control arm order alternates.
primaryOutcome: Does reasoning or coaching falsely diagnose a premium-limit defect on the archived run? Overall refusal alone is not success: unrelated UI issues and an unverified limit may still warrant refusal. Manually inspect full reasons.
controls: Six authored scenarios, paired baseline/candidate: failed setup, real defect, verified limit, wrong refusal cause, unknown initial state, known existing state. Check approval and diagnosis independently.
scope: Tool-free replay of archived validator user input using current production baseline system prompt versus only added stateful guidance. No Atoma run, state or trust mutation. Controls are synthetic, explicitly labelled.
limits: Small exploratory comparison of one incident; no general reliability or end-to-end execution claim.
